jobs.title: Servicetechniker (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Date Posted:
2026-07-14Country:
SwitzerlandLocation:
Sandackerstrasse 26, 9245 Oberburen

Was dich bei uns erwartet

Du bist verantwortlich für den reibungslosen Betrieb unserer Anlagen in der Region St.Gallen. Dies beinhaltet folgende Aufgaben:

• Du führst regelmässige Wartungs- und Reparaturarbeiten an mechanischen, hydraulischen, elektrischen und elektronischen Komponenten von Aufzügen und Fahrtreppen durch

• Du identifizierst selbstständig Reparatur- und Verbesserungsarbeiten an den Anlagen und bestellst die nötigen Ersatzteile

• Du führst mit Hilfe moderner Hilfsmittel Fehlersuchen durch und beseitigst die Störungen

Was wir von dir erwarten

• Du hast eine abgeschlossene technische Ausbildung wie Elektromonteur:in, Polymechaniker:in, Automobilfachmann:frau oder ähnlich. Wenn du dich mit Liften bereits auskennst ist das ein grosser Vorteil.

• Du sprichst fliessend Deutsch

• Du planst und koordinierst eigenständig deinen Tag und legst ein freundliches Auftreten an den Tag

• Einen Führerschein der Kategorie B setzen wir voraus, ebenso wie einen Wohnort im Einsatzgebiet damit du die Pikettzeiten einhalten kannst

Was wir dir bieten

• Bei deinem Start bei uns wirst du von einem erfahrenen Kollegen begleitet, welcher dir wertvolles Fachwissen auf deinen Weg mitgibt.

• Du wirst mit einem Mobiltelefon und einem eigenen Firmenfahrzeug ausgestattet, welches du auch privat benutzen darfst.

• Uns liegt deine persönliche Entwicklung am Herzen. Konkret bedeutet dies, dass wir Weiterbildungen unterstützen und interne Beförderungsmöglichkeiten jedem offenstehen.

• Gute Pensionskasse

• 5 Wochen Ferien

• Verpflegungszuschuss

Unsere Firmenkultur ist unser wichtigstes Gut und ist tief im Unternehmen verankert und wird von allen Mitarbeitern gelebt und geschätzt. Mehr Informationen über unsere «Otis Absolutes» findest Du hier.

Steige ein – Steige auf!

Haben wir dich überzeugt? Dann wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung.

If you live in a city, chances are we will give you a lift or play a role in keeping you moving every day.

Otis is the world’s leading elevator and escalator manufacturing, installation, and service company. We move 2.4 billion people every day and maintain approximately 2.4 million customer units worldwide, the industry's largest Service portfolio.

You may recognize our products in some of the world’s most famous landmarks including the Eiffel Tower, Empire State Building, Burj Khalifa and the Petronas Twin Towers! We are 72,000 people strong, including engineers, digital technology experts, sales, and functional specialists, as well as factory and field technicians, all committed to meeting the diverse needs of our customers and passengers in more than 200 countries and territories worldwide. We are proud to be a diverse, global team with a proven legacy of innovation that continues to be the bedrock of a fast-moving, high-performance company.

When you join Otis, you become part of an innovative global industry leader with a resilient business model. You’ll belong to a diverse, trusted, and caring community where your contributions, and the skills and capabilities you’ll gain working alongside the best and brightest, keep us connected and on the cutting edge.

We provide opportunities, training, and resources, that build leadership and capabilities in Sales, Field, Engineering and Major Projects and our Employee Scholar Program is a notable point of pride, through which Otis sponsors colleagues to pursue degrees or certification programs.

Today, our focus more than ever is on people. As a global, people-powered company, we put people – passengers, customers, and colleagues – at the center of everything we do.  We are guided by our values that we call our Three Absolutes – prioritizing Safety, Ethics, Quality in all that we do. If you would like to learn more about environmental, social and governance (ESG) at Otis click here.

Become a part of the Otis team and help us #Buildwhatsnext!
Otis is An Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status, age, or any other protected class according to applicable law. To request an accommodation in completing an employment application due to a special need or a disability, please contact us at careers@otis.com.

jobs.title: Service Technician
jobs.description:
Date Posted:
2026-07-08Country:
SwitzerlandLocation:
Route de Moncor 12, CP 464, 1701 Fribourg
Fonction de Base
Garantir le fonctionnement des ascenseurs au moyen de travaux d’entretien réguliers et de travaux de réparation dans la région de Neuchâtel.

Responsabilités

• Optimiser et assurer ses tournées journalières de visites et de contrôles

• Assurer les travaux d’entretien réguliers sur composants mécaniques, hydrauliques, électriques et électroniques d’ascenseurs et d'escalators dans le cercle de service attribué, conformément au manuel de maintenance

• Identifier et proposer des travaux de réparation et amélioration (T & CC) au superviseur

• Identifier et commander les références des pièces détachées nécessaires

• Assurer les travaux de réparation "Circuit Court" (CC)

• Utiliser les menus de diagnostic et de paramétrage des outils de dépannage

• Diagnostiquer et résoudre une panne

• Libérer les personnes bloquées dans l‘ascenseur

• Connaitre les endroits/systèmes ou trouver les informations techniques

• Assurer un service de piquet régulier

Qualifications/ Expérience/ Connaissances

• Au bénéfice d'un CFC dans le domaine électrique ou équivalent avec idéalement plusieurs années d'expérience dans le monde de l'ascenseur.

• Afin de pouvoir garantir la disponibilité pendant le service de piquet, il est indispensable que le collaborateur réside dans la région de travail.

• Connaissance langue Française est indispensable

• Le permis de conduire valable sur le territoire suisse est exigé

• Orientation client, sens du service

• Organisation, capacité d’analyse et sens des priorités

Ce que nous t'offrons

• Nous vous offrons une rémunération conforme aux exigences locales, ainsi que :

• Treizième mois

• Contribution de l’entreprise aux cotisations santé & prévoyance, avantages du comité d’entreprise

• 5 semaines de vacances

• 5 jours à Noel (selon le rôle)

Kreuzstrasse 34, 6010 Kriens

Grundlegende Funktion
Du gehörst zu der Abteilung Modernisierung, bringst also alte Anlagen wieder in Schwung. Ausserdem bist du verantwortlich für die Montage neuer Liftanlagen in bestehenden Gebäuden. Dazu gehören folgende Aufgaben:

Hauptaufgaben

• Durchführung der nötigen Reparaturen und Umbauarbeiten an Anlagen, um diesen damit eine längere Lebensdauer zu geben

• Entgegennahme von Material und entsprechende Vorbereitung der Baustelle

• Montage der gesamten mechanischen und elektrischen Komponenten unserer Anlagen

• Inbetriebnahme der fertiggestellten Anlagen

• Übergabe an die Kundschaft

Qualifikationen/ Erfahrung/ Kenntnisse

• Du hast eine abgeschlossene technische Ausbildung wie Elektromonteur:in, Polymechaniker:in, Automobilfachmann:frau oder ähnlich. Wenn du dich mit Liften bereits auskennst, ist das ein grosser Vorteil.

• Du sprichst fliessend Deutsch

• Du trägst gerne Eigenverantwortung und bist dir nicht zu schade deine Hände auch mal dreckig zu machen

• Du planst und koordinierst eigenständig deinen Tag und legst ein freundliches Auftreten an den Tag

• Einen Führerschein der Kategorie B setzen wir voraus

Was wir dir bieten

• Es erwartet dich eine Aufgabe mit viel Freiraum und Verantwortung

• Du wirst von einer Fachperson top eingearbeitet und begleitet

• Ausserdem wirst du mit einem Mobiltelefon und einem eigenen Firmenfahrzeug ausgestattet, welches du auch privat benutzen darfst.

• Uns liegt deine persönliche Entwicklung am Herzen. Konkret bedeutet dies, dass wir Weiterbildungen unterstützen und interne Beförderungsmöglichkeiten jedem offenstehen.

• 5 Wochen Ferien

• Gute Pensionskasse

• Verpflegungszuschuss

Unsere Firmenkultur ist unser wichtigstes Gut, ist tief im Unternehmen verankert und wird von allen Mitarbeitern gelebt und geschätzt. Mehr Informationen über unsere «Otis Absolutes» findest Du hier.

Steige ein - steige auf!
Unser Recruiting Team freut sich auf deine Bewerbung durch unser Bewerbungsportal.

If you live in a city, chances are we will give you a lift or play a role in keeping you moving every day.

Otis is the world’s leading elevator and escalator manufacturing, installation, and service company. We move 2.4 billion people every day and maintain approximately 2.4 million customer units worldwide, the industry's largest Service portfolio.

You may recognize our products in some of the world’s most famous landmarks including the Eiffel Tower, Empire State Building, Burj Khalifa and the Petronas Twin Towers! We are 72,000 people strong, including engineers, digital technology experts, sales, and functional specialists, as well as factory and field technicians, all committed to meeting the diverse needs of our customers and passengers in more than 200 countries and territories worldwide. We are proud to be a diverse, global team with a proven legacy of innovation that continues to be the bedrock of a fast-moving, high-performance company.

When you join Otis, you become part of an innovative global industry leader with a resilient business model. You’ll belong to a diverse, trusted, and caring community where your contributions, and the skills and capabilities you’ll gain working alongside the best and brightest, keep us connected and on the cutting edge.

We provide opportunities, training, and resources, that build leadership and capabilities in Sales, Field, Engineering and Major Projects and our Employee Scholar Program is a notable point of pride, through which Otis sponsors colleagues to pursue degrees or certification programs.

Today, our focus more than ever is on people. As a global, people-powered company, we put people – passengers, customers, and colleagues – at the center of everything we do.  We are guided by our values that we call our Three Absolutes – prioritizing Safety, Ethics, Quality in all that we do. Du identifizierst Bauvorhaben in der Region Zentralschweiz, erstellst passende Offerten und führst eigenständig den gesamten Verkaufsprozess bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss.

• Abgeschlossene technische oder kaufmännische Ausbildung

We are 72,000 people strong, including engineers, digital technology experts, sales, and functional specialists, as well as factory and field technicians, all committed to meeting the diverse needs of our customers and passengers in more than 200 countries and territories worldwide. We are proud to be a diverse, global team with a proven legacy of innovation that continues to be the bedrock of a fast-moving, high-performance company.

When you join Otis, you become part of an innovative global industry leader with a resilient business model. • Durchführung der nötigen Reparaturen und Umbauarbeiten an Anlagen, um diesen damit eine längere Lebensdauer zu geben

• Entgegennahme von Material und entsprechende Vorbereitung der Baustelle

• Einen Führerschein der Kategorie B setzen wir voraus

• Es erwartet dich eine Aufgabe mit viel Freiraum und Verantwortung

• Du wirst von einer Fachperson top eingearbeitet und begleitet

• Uns liegt deine persönliche Entwicklung am Herzen. Konkret bedeutet dies, dass wir Weiterbildungen unterstützen und interne Beförderungsmöglichkeiten jedem offenstehen.

Date Posted:
2026-01-05Country:
SwitzerlandLocation:
Route de Moncor 12, CP 464, 1701 Fribourg
Rejoignez le Vivier de Talents d’Otis Suisse – Région Fribourg

*Remarque importante
Ce poste fait partie de notre vivier de talents. S’il n’existe pas d’opportunité ouverte correspondant immédiatement à votre profil, nous serons ravis d’ajouter votre candidature à notre base de professionnels qualifiés et nous vous contacterons dès qu’un rôle adapté se libère.

Pourquoi Otis ?
Chez Otis, leader mondial du transport vertical, nous améliorons chaque jour la mobilité urbaine grâce à l’innovation, la sécurité et l’excellence opérationnelle.
Rejoindre Otis, c’est évoluer dans une entreprise où :

• La sécurité passe avant tout

• La qualité est un engagement quotidien

• L’éthique, la collaboration et la croissance guident nos actions

• Les collaborateurs sont au cœur de la réussite

Votre future équipe - Talent Otis Fribourg
Nous recherchons en permanence des professionnels passionnés pour rejoindre nos équipes :

• Monteurs / Installateurs

• Techniciens de service

• Techniciens Repair / Modernisation

Si vous êtes motivé par la technologie, l’innovation et un service client irréprochable, votre place est peut-être parmi nous.

Vos compétences & votre profil
Nous serions ravis d’échanger avec vous si vous disposez de :

• Un CFC d’électricien, électronicien, mécano-électro, mécanicien, polymécanicien ou formation équivalente

• Plusieurs années d’expérience dans le domaine technique, idéalement dans l’ascenseur

• Une résidence dans un rayon de 30 km du lieu de départ de service

• La maîtrise du français (niveau courant indispensable)

• Un permis de conduire valable en Suisse

• Une capacité et un confort pour travailler en hauteur

Ce que nous vous offrons
Chez Otis, la culture d’entreprise est un pilier essentiel. Nos valeurs – Les Absolus Otis – guident nos actions quotidiennes et créent un environnement où chacun peut évoluer et s’épanouir.
Nous proposons :

• Une rémunération compétitive, alignée avec les standards locaux

• Un 13ᵉ mois

• Des primes liées aux résultats

• Une contribution de l’entreprise à vos cotisations santé et prévoyance

• Les avantages du comité d’entreprise

• 5 semaines de vacances

• Jusqu’à 5 jours de pont à Noël (selon les rôles)

Envie de faire partie de l’aventure Otis ?
Transmettez-nous votre candidature pour rejoindre notre vivier de talents.

If you live in a city, chances are we will give you a lift or play a role in keeping you moving every day.

Otis is the world’s leading elevator and escalator manufacturing, installation, and service company. We move 2.4 billion people every day and maintain approximately 2.4 million customer units worldwide, the industry's largest Service portfolio.

You may recognize our products in some of the world’s most famous landmarks including the Eiffel Tower, Empire State Building, Burj Khalifa and the Petronas Twin Towers! We are 72,000 people strong, including engineers, digital technology experts, sales, and functional specialists, as well as factory and field technicians, all committed to meeting the diverse needs of our customers and passengers in more than 200 countries and territories worldwide. We are proud to be a diverse, global team with a proven legacy of innovation that continues to be the bedrock of a fast-moving, high-performance company.

When you join Otis, you become part of an innovative global industry leader with a resilient business model. You’ll belong to a diverse, trusted, and caring community where your contributions, and the skills and capabilities you’ll gain working alongside the best and brightest, keep us connected and on the cutting edge.

We provide opportunities, training, and resources, that build leadership and capabilities in Sales, Field, Engineering and Major Projects and our Employee Scholar Program is a notable point of pride, through which Otis sponsors colleagues to pursue degrees or certification programs.

Today, our focus more than ever is on people. As a global, people-powered company, we put people – passengers, customers, and colleagues – at the center of everything we do.  We are guided by our values that we call our Three Absolutes – prioritizing Safety, Ethics, Quality in all that we do. If you would like to learn more about environmental, social and governance (ESG) at Otis click here.

Become a part of the Otis team and help us #Buildwhatsnext!
Otis is An Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status, age, or any other protected class according to applicable law. To request an accommodation in completing an employment application due to a special need or a disability, please contact us at careers@otis.com.

Siamo 72.000 persone, tra ingegneri, esperti di tecnologia digitale, vendite e specialisti funzionali, oltre a tecnici di fabbrica e di campo, tutti impegnati a soddisfare le esigenze dei nostri clienti e passeggeri in più di 200 paesi e territori nel mondo. Siamo orgogliosi di essere un team diversificato e globale con una lunga storia di innovazione che continua a essere la base di un’azienda ad alte prestazioni in rapido movimento. Quando entri in Otis, diventi parte di un leader globale innovativo con un modello di business resiliente. Farai parte di una comunità diversificata, affidabile e premurosa, dove i tuoi contributi, le competenze e le capacità che acquisirai lavorando con i migliori e più brillanti ci tengono connessi e all’avanguardia.
• Offriamo opportunità, formazione e risorse che sviluppano leadership e capacità in Vendite, Campo, Ingegneria e Grandi Progetti. Il nostro Employee Scholar Program è motivo di orgoglio, attraverso il quale Otis sponsorizza colleghi per conseguire lauree o certificazioni. Oggi, il nostro focus più che mai è sulle persone. Come azienda globale, orientata alle persone, mettiamo le persone – passeggeri, clienti e colleghi – al centro di tutto ciò che facciamo. Siamo guidati dai nostri valori, che chiamiamo i nostri Tre Assoluti – prioritizzando Sicurezza, Etica, Qualità in tutto ciò che facciamo. Se vuoi saperne di più su ambiente, sociale e governance (ESG) in Otis, clicca qui. Diventa parte del team Otis e aiutaci a #Buildwhatsnext! Otis è un datore di lavoro che offre pari opportunità. Tutti i candidati qualificati riceveranno considerazione per l’impiego senza riguardo a razza, colore, religione, sesso, orientamento sessuale, identità di genere, origine nazionale, disabilità o stato di veterano, età o qualsiasi altra categoria protetta secondo la legge applicabile. Per richiedere un accomodamento nella compilazione della domanda di lavoro a causa di una necessità speciale o disabilità, contattaci all’indirizzo careers@otis.com.

Falls derzeit keine offene Position vorhanden ist, die Ihrem Profil entspricht, freuen wir uns, Ihre Bewerbung in unserer Datenbank qualifizierter Fachkräfte zu speichern und Sie zu kontaktieren, sobald eine passende Stelle frei wird.* ## Warum Otis? Bei Otis zu arbeiten bedeutet, sich in einem Unternehmen weiterzuentwickeln, in dem: - Sicherheit oberste Priorität hat - Qualität eine tägliche Verpflichtung ist - Ethik, Zusammenarbeit und Wachstum unsere Handlungen leiten - Mitarbeitende im Mittelpunkt unseres Erfolgs stehen ## Dein zukünftiges Team - Talent Otis Freiburg Wir suchen ständig engagierte Fachkräfte, die unser Team verstärken: - Monteure / Installateure - Servicetechniker - Reparatur / Modernisierungstechniker Wenn du von Technologie, Innovation und exzellentem Kundenservice begeistert bist, könnte dein Platz bei uns sein. ## Kompetenzen und Profil Wir freuen uns, mit dir zu sprechen, wenn du: - Eine Ausbildung als Elektriker, Elektroniker, Mechatroniker, Mechaniker, Polymonteur oder eine gleichwertige Qualifikation hast - Mehrjährige Erfahrung im technischen Bereich, idealerweise im Aufzugswesen - In einem Umkreis von 30 km vom Einsatzort wohnst - Fließend Französisch sprichst (guter Sprachgebrauch erforderlich) - Einen gültigen Führerschein in der Schweiz besitzt - Die Fähigkeit und Bereitschaft hast, in der Höhe zu arbeiten ##

• Une résidence dans un rayon de 30 km du lieu de départ de service

• La maîtrise du français (niveau courant indispensable)

• Un permis de conduire valable en Suisse

• Une capacité et un confort pour travailler en hauteur

Chez Otis, la culture d’entreprise est un pilier essentiel. Nos valeurs – Les Absolus Otis guident nos actions quotidiennes et créent un environnement où chacun peut évoluer et s’épanouir.

• Des primes liées aux résultats

Envie de faire partie de l’aventure Otis ?

If you live in a city, chances are we will give you a lift or play a role in keeping you moving every day.

Otis is the world’s leading elevator and escalator manufacturing, installation, and service company. We move 2.4 billion people every day and maintain approximately 2.4 million customer units worldwide, the industry's largest Service portfolio.

You may recognize our products in some of the world’s most famous landmarks including the Eiffel Tower, Empire State Building, Burj Khalifa and the Petronas Twin Towers! We are 72,000 people strong, including engineers, digital technology experts, sales, and functional specialists, as well as factory and field technicians, all committed to meeting the diverse needs of our customers and passengers in more than 200 countries and territories worldwide. We are proud to be a diverse, global team with a proven legacy of innovation that continues to be the bedrock of a fast-moving, high-performance company.

When you join Otis, you become part of an innovative global industry leader with a resilient business model. You’ll belong to a diverse, trusted, and caring community where your contributions, and the skills and capabilities you’ll gain working alongside the best and brightest, keep us connected and on the cutting edge.

We provide opportunities, training, and resources, that build leadership and capabilities in Sales, Field, Engineering and Major Projects and our Employee Scholar Program is a notable point of pride, through which Otis sponsors colleagues to pursue degrees or certification programs.

Today, our focus more than ever is on people. As a global, people-powered company, we put people – passengers, customers, and colleagues – at the center of everything we do. Date Posted:
2026-01-05Country:
SwitzerlandLocation:
Chemin des Mésanges 5, 1032, Romanel-sur-Lausanne
Rejoignez le Vivier de Talents d’Otis Suisse – Région Vaud

*Remarque importante
Ce poste fait partie de notre vivier de talents. S’il n’existe pas d’opportunité ouverte correspondant immédiatement à votre profil, nous serons ravis d’ajouter votre candidature à notre base de professionnels qualifiés et nous vous contacterons dès qu’un rôle adapté se libère.

Pourquoi Otis ?
Chez Otis, leader mondial du transport vertical, nous améliorons chaque jour la mobilité urbaine grâce à l’innovation, la sécurité et l’excellence opérationnelle.
Rejoindre Otis, c’est évoluer dans une entreprise où :

• La sécurité passe avant tout

• La qualité est un engagement quotidien

• L’éthique, la collaboration et la croissance guident nos actions

• Les collaborateurs sont au cœur de la réussite

Votre future équipe - Talent Otis Vaud
Nous recherchons en permanence des professionnels passionnés pour rejoindre nos équipes :

• Monteurs / Installateurs

• Techniciens de service

• Techniciens Repair / Modernisation

Si vous êtes motivé par la technologie, l’innovation et un service client irréprochable, votre place est peut-être parmi nous.

Vos compétences & votre profil
Nous serions ravis d’échanger avec vous si vous disposez de :

• Un CFC d’électricien, électronicien, mécano-électro, mécanicien, polymécanicien ou formation équivalente

• Plusieurs années d’expérience dans le domaine technique, idéalement dans l’ascenseur

• Une résidence dans un rayon de 30 km du lieu de départ de service

• La maîtrise du français (niveau courant indispensable)

• Un permis de conduire valable en Suisse

• Une capacité et un confort pour travailler en hauteur

Ce que nous vous offrons
Chez Otis, la culture d’entreprise est un pilier essentiel. Nos valeurs – Les Absolus Otis – guident nos actions quotidiennes et créent un environnement où chacun peut évoluer et s’épanouir.
Nous proposons :

• Une rémunération compétitive, alignée avec les standards locaux

• Un 13ᵉ mois

• Des primes liées aux résultats

• Une contribution de l’entreprise à vos cotisations santé et prévoyance

• Les avantages du comité d’entreprise

• 5 semaines de vacances

• Jusqu’à 5 jours de pont à Noël (selon les rôles)

Envie de faire partie de l’aventure Otis ?
Transmettez-nous votre candidature pour rejoindre notre vivier de talents.

If you live in a city, chances are we will give you a lift or play a role in keeping you moving every day.

Otis is the world’s leading elevator and escalator manufacturing, installation, and service company. We move 2.4 billion people every day and maintain approximately 2.4 million customer units worldwide, the industry's largest Service portfolio.

You may recognize our products in some of the world’s most famous landmarks including the Eiffel Tower, Empire State Building, Burj Khalifa and the Petronas Twin Towers! We are 72,000 people strong, including engineers, digital technology experts, sales, and functional specialists, as well as factory and field technicians, all committed to meeting the diverse needs of our customers and passengers in more than 200 countries and territories worldwide. We are proud to be a diverse, global team with a proven legacy of innovation that continues to be the bedrock of a fast-moving, high-performance company.

When you join Otis, you become part of an innovative global industry leader with a resilient business model. You’ll belong to a diverse, trusted, and caring community where your contributions, and the skills and capabilities you’ll gain working alongside the best and brightest, keep us connected and on the cutting edge.

We provide opportunities, training, and resources, that build leadership and capabilities in Sales, Field, Engineering and Major Projects and our Employee Scholar Program is a notable point of pride, through which Otis sponsors colleagues to pursue degrees or certification programs.

Today, our focus more than ever is on people. As a global, people-powered company, we put people – passengers, customers, and colleagues – at the center of everything we do.  We are guided by our values that we call our Three Absolutes – prioritizing Safety, Ethics, Quality in all that we do. If you would like to learn more about environmental, social and governance (ESG) at Otis click here.

Become a part of the Otis team and help us #Buildwhatsnext!
Otis is An Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status, age, or any other protected class according to applicable law. To request an accommodation in completing an employment application due to a special need or a disability, please contact us at careers@otis.com.

• Ihr Profil Wir freuen uns, mit Ihnen zu sprechen, wenn Sie über: - Eine Ausbildung als Elektriker, Elektroniker, Mechatroniker, Mechaniker, Polymecaniker oder eine gleichwertige Qualifikation verfügen - Mehrjährige Erfahrung im technischen Bereich, idealerweise im Aufzugsbereich - Wohnsitz im Umkreis von 30 km vom Einsatzort - Fließende Französischkenntnisse (erforderlich) - Einen gültigen Führerschein in der Schweiz - Die Fähigkeit und Bereitschaft, in der Höhe zu arbeiten ## Was wir Ihnen bieten Bei Otis ist Unternehmenskultur ein wesentlicher Pfeiler. • Wir bieten: - Wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt, angepasst an lokale Standards - Einen 13. Monatslohn - Ergebnisabhängige Boni - Einen Beitrag des Unternehmens zu Ihren Kranken- und Vorsorgebeiträgen - Vorteile des Betriebsrats - 5 Wochen Urlaub - Bis zu 5 Brückentage zu Weihnachten (je nach Rolle) ## Kontakt Möchten Sie Teil des Otis-Teams werden? Senden Sie uns Ihre Bewerbung, um unserem Talent-Pool beizutreten. Wenn Sie in einer Stadt leben, bringen wir Sie wahrscheinlich mit dem Auto hin oder sorgen dafür, dass Sie täglich in Bewegung bleiben. Otis ist der weltweit führende Hersteller, Installateur und Serviceanbieter für Aufzüge und Rolltreppen. Wir bewegen täglich 2,4 Milliarden Menschen und warten rund 2,4 Millionen Kundenanlagen weltweit, das größte Service-Portfolio der Branche. Sie erkennen unsere Produkte vielleicht an einigen der berühmtesten Wahrzeichen der Welt, darunter den Eiffelturm, das Empire State Building, den Burj Khalifa und die Petronas Twin Towers! Wir sind 72.000 Mitarbeitende, darunter Ingenieure, Experten für digitale Technologien, Vertrieb und Fachspezialisten sowie Fabrik- und Außendiensttechniker, die alle engagiert sind, die vielfältigen Bedürfnisse unserer Kunden und Passagiere in mehr als 200 Ländern und Gebieten weltweit zu erfüllen. Wir sind stolz auf unser diverses, globale Team mit einer bewährten Innovationsgeschichte, die das Fundament eines schnelllebigen, leistungsstarken Unternehmens bildet. Wenn Sie bei Otis einsteigen, werden Sie Teil eines innovativen globalen Branchenführers mit einem widerstandsfähigen Geschäftsmodell. Sie gehören einer vielfältigen, vertrauenswürdigen und fürsorglichen Gemeinschaft an, in der Ihre Beiträge sowie die Fähigkeiten und Kompetenzen, die Sie durch die Zusammenarbeit mit den Besten und Klügsten erwerben, uns verbunden und an der Spitze halten.

Heute liegt unser Fokus mehr denn je auf den Menschen. Als globales, menschenorientiertes Unternehmen stellen wir Menschen – Passagiere, Kunden und Kollegen – in den Mittelpunkt unseres Handelns. Unsere Werte, die wir unsere Drei Absolute nennen – Sicherheit, Ethik, Qualität – leiten alles, was wir tun. Wenn Sie mehr über Umwelt-, Sozial- und Governance-Themen (ESG) bei Otis erfahren möchten, klicken Sie hier. Werden Sie Teil des Otis-Teams und helfen Sie uns, #Buildwhatsnext! Date Posted:
2025-06-25Country:
SwitzerlandLocation:
Nenzlingerweg 2, 4153 Reinach
Werde Teil unseres Teams in Basel!

Wir suchen talentierte Servicetechniker:innen, um die Innovation und Exzellenz bei Otis Schweiz voranzutreiben.

Was dich bei uns erwartet

Du bist verantwortlich für den reibungslosen Betrieb unserer Anlagen. Dies beinhaltet folgende Aufgaben:

• Du führst regelmässige Wartungs- und Reparaturarbeiten an mechanischen, hydraulischen, elektrischen und elektronischen Komponenten von Aufzügen und Fahrtreppen durch

• Du identifizierst selbstständig Reparatur- und Verbesserungsarbeiten an den Anlagen und bestellst die nötigen Ersatzteile

• Du führst mit Hilfe moderner Hilfsmittel Fehlersuchen durch und beseitigst die Störungen

Was wir von dir erwarten

• Du hast eine abgeschlossene technische Ausbildung wie Elektromonteur:in, Polymechaniker:in, Automobilfachmann:frau oder ähnlich. Wenn du dich mit Liften bereits auskennst ist das ein grosser Vorteil.

Otis dà alle persone la possibilità di connettersi in un mondo più grande, più veloce e più intelligente. Come principale azienda mondiale nella produzione, installazione e manutenzione di ascensori e scale mobili, muoviamo quotidianamente 2.4 miliardi di persone e disponiamo di oltre 2.4 milioni di impianti, il più grande portafoglio di manutenzione dell'industria. - La sicurezza ha la massima priorità - La qualità è una promessa quotidiana - Etica, collaborazione e sviluppo continuo sono elementi fissi della nostra cultura aziendale - I nostri dipendenti sono al centro del nostro successo Maggiori informazioni sui nostri «Otis Absolutes» le trovi qui. Potresti riconoscere i nostri prodotti in alcune delle più famose mete del mondo, tra cui la Torre Eiffel, l'Empire State Building, il Burj Khalifa e le Torri Petronas! Siamo una squadra di 72.000 persone, tra ingegneri, esperti di tecnologia digitale, vendite e specialisti funzionali, nonché tecnici di fabbrica e campo, tutti impegnati a soddisfare le esigenze diverse dei nostri clienti e passeggeri in oltre 200 paesi e territori in tutto il mondo. Siamo orgogliosi di essere una squadra globale e diversificata con una prova di innovazione che continua a essere la base di un'azienda ad alto rendimento e in rapida crescita. Quando ti unisci a Otis, fai parte di un leader globale innovativo con un modello aziendale resiliente. Farai parte di una comunità diversificata, affidabile e premuroso dove i tuoi contributi e le competenze e capacità che acquisterai lavorando insieme ai migliori e ai più brillanti, ci tengono connessi e all'avanguardia. Ti offriamo opportunità, formazione e risorse che costruiscono leadership e capacità in Vendite, Campo, Ingegneria e Progetti di Ingegneria e il nostro programma Employee Scholar è un punto di orgoglio, attraverso il quale Otis sponsorizza i colleghi per perseguire lauree o programmi di certificazione. Siamo guidati dai nostri valori che chiamiamo i nostri Tre Assoluti - priorità di Sicurezza, Etica, Qualità in tutto ciò che facciamo. Otis è un'azienda che promuove l'uguaglianza di opportunità. Tutti i candidati qualificati riceveranno considerazione per l'impiego senza riguardo alla razza, colore, religione, sesso, orientamento sessuale, identità di genere, origine nazionale, disabilità o stato di veterano, età o qualsiasi altra classe protetta secondo le leggi applicabili. Per richiedere un adattamento nella compilazione di una domanda di lavoro a causa di una necessità speciale o di una disabilità, ti preghiamo di contattarci a careers@otis.com. Date Posted:
2025-01-14Country:
SwitzerlandLocation:
Triststrasse 8, 7000 Chur

Werde Teil unseres Teams in Chur!

Wichtiger Hinweis
Diese Ausschreibung bezieht sich nicht auf eine aktuell offene Position. Sollte derzeit keine passende Stelle für Dein Profil verfügbar sein, nehmen wir Deine Bewerbung gerne in unseren Talentpool auf. Wir informieren Dich , sobald eine geeignete Position frei wird, die Deinen Qualifikationen und Interessen entspricht.

Zur Verstärkung unserer Teams suchen wir engagierte Fachkräfte in folgenden Bereichen:

• Monteur:innen (Neuanlagen und Modernisierung)

• Servicetechniker:innen

• Reparateur:inen

Voraussetzungen

• Abgeschlossene technische Ausbildung wie Elektriker:in, Elektromonteur:in, Mechaniker:in, Polymechaniker:in oder ähnlich.

• Wenn du dich mit Liften bereits auskennst ist das ein grosser Vorteil

• Du sprichst fliessend Deutsch

• Einen Führerschein der Kategorie B setzen wir voraus, ebenso wie einen Wohnort im Einsatzgebiet

Was wir Dir bieten

• Marktgerechte und wettbewerbsfähige Vergütung

• Erfolgsprämien

• Gute Pensionskasse

• 5 Wochen Urlaub

• Verpflegungszuschuss

• Du wirst von einer Fachperson top eingearbeitet und begleitet

• Du bekommst ein Firmenfahrzeug für die Arbeit und Privat

• Du wirst von uns unterstützt und hast großartige Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten

Warum Otis?
Otis gibt Menschen die Möglichkeit, sich in einer größeren, schnelleren und intelligenteren Welt zu verbinden. Als weltweit führendes Unternehmen in der  Herstellung, Installation und Wartung von Aufzügen und Fahrtreppen bewegen wir täglich 2.4 Milliarden Menschen und verfügen mit über 2.4 Millionen Anlagen über das weltweite größte Wartungsportfolio der Branche.

• Sicherheit hat oberste Priorität

• Qualität ist ein tägliches Versprechen

• Ethik, Zusammenarbeit und stetige Weiterentwicklung sind feste Bestandteile unserer Unternehmens­kultur

• Unsere Mitarbeitenden stehen im Mittelpunkt unseres Erfolgs

Mehr Informationen über unsere «Otis Absolutes» findest Du hier.

Steige ein – Steige auf!
Haben wir Dich überzeugt? Dann freuen wir uns auf Deine Bewerbung! Bitte teile uns in deinem Anschreiben mit, für welche der drei Positionen Du dich interessierst.

If you live in a city, chances are we will give you a lift or play a role in keeping you moving every day.

Otis is the world’s leading elevator and escalator manufacturing, installation, and service company. We move 2.4 billion people every day and maintain approximately 2.4 million customer units worldwide, the industry's largest Service portfolio.

You may recognize our products in some of the world’s most famous landmarks including the Eiffel Tower, Empire State Building, Burj Khalifa and the Petronas Twin Towers! We are 72,000 people strong, including engineers, digital technology experts, sales, and functional specialists, as well as factory and field technicians, all committed to meeting the diverse needs of our customers and passengers in more than 200 countries and territories worldwide. We are proud to be a diverse, global team with a proven legacy of innovation that continues to be the bedrock of a fast-moving, high-performance company.

When you join Otis, you become part of an innovative global industry leader with a resilient business model. You’ll belong to a diverse, trusted, and caring community where your contributions, and the skills and capabilities you’ll gain working alongside the best and brightest, keep us connected and on the cutting edge.

We provide opportunities, training, and resources, that build leadership and capabilities in Sales, Field, Engineering and Major Projects and our Employee Scholar Program is a notable point of pride, through which Otis sponsors colleagues to pursue degrees or certification programs.

Today, our focus more than ever is on people. As a global, people-powered company, we put people – passengers, customers, and colleagues – at the center of everything we do.  We are guided by our values that we call our Three Absolutes – prioritizing Safety, Ethics, Quality in all that we do. If you would like to learn more about environmental, social and governance (ESG) at Otis click here.

Become a part of the Otis team and help us #Buildwhatsnext!
Otis is An Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status, age, or any other protected class according to applicable law. To request an accommodation in completing an employment application due to a special need or a disability, please contact us at careers@otis.com.

jobs.description:
Date Posted:
2026-06-01Country:
SwitzerlandLocation:
Route de Moncor 12, CP 464, 1701 Fribourg
Role Overview:

The FP&A Manager is responsible for leading the financial planning, forecasting, budgeting, and analysis activities for Otis Switzerland. This role acts as a strategic business partner to operational and commercial teams, delivering financial insights that drive performance, profitability, and long-term growth. The ideal candidate will combine strong financial acumen with business understanding and an ability to challenge assumptions, identify risks and opportunities, and support data-driven decision-making.

Key Responsibilities:

Financial Planning and Budgeting:

• Lead the annual budget and quarterly forecast processes, working closely with regional teams, sales, service, and operations.

• Consolidate financial plans and prepare scenario analyses to support management decisions.

Performance Analysis and Reporting:

• Monitor key financial metrics (e.g., revenue, margin, OPEX, working capital) and provide actionable insights to senior leadership.

• Prepare monthly performance reports, dashboards, and variance analyses against budget and forecast.

Strategic Business Support:

• Partner with commercial, service, and operations leaders to evaluate business performance and support strategic initiatives such as pricing strategies, cost optimization, or capital investment.

• Provide financial input for business cases, tenders, and investment proposals (e.g., modernization projects, new installations, or M&A activity).

Cash Flow and Working Capital Management:

• Support the monitoring and forecasting of cash flow, collections, and project-related working capital.

• Analyze trends in billing, collections, and inventory to improve capital efficiency.

Tools, Systems & Process Improvement:

• Drive improvements in FP&A tools, models, and processes, ensuring scalability and accuracy of financial insights.

• Collaborate with IT and Controlling to streamline data flow and reporting systems (e.g., ERP, BI tools).

Governance and Compliance:

• Ensure adherence to internal controls, group policies, and financial reporting standards.

• Support audits and internal reviews related to financial planning and forecasting.

Qualifications, Competencies and Skills:

• Bachelor’s or master’s degree in accounting, Finance, or a related field.

• Proficiency in both German & English. French and Italian are a plus.

• Extensive experience in accounting and good understanding of construction accounting practices, including job costing, percentage of completion, and project-based financial management.

• Proficiency with accounting software and advanced Excel skills.

• Strong leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills to collaborate with business partners and the different departments across Otis Switzerland

If you live in a city, chances are we will give you a lift or play a role in keeping you moving every day.

Otis is the world’s leading elevator and escalator manufacturing, installation, and service company. We move 2.4 billion people every day and maintain approximately 2.4 million customer units worldwide, the industry's largest Service portfolio.

You may recognize our products in some of the world’s most famous landmarks including the Eiffel Tower, Empire State Building, Burj Khalifa and the Petronas Twin Towers! We are 72,000 people strong, including engineers, digital technology experts, sales, and functional specialists, as well as factory and field technicians, all committed to meeting the diverse needs of our customers and passengers in more than 200 countries and territories worldwide. We are proud to be a diverse, global team with a proven legacy of innovation that continues to be the bedrock of a fast-moving, high-performance company.

When you join Otis, you become part of an innovative global industry leader with a resilient business model. You’ll belong to a diverse, trusted, and caring community where your contributions, and the skills and capabilities you’ll gain working alongside the best and brightest, keep us connected and on the cutting edge.

We provide opportunities, training, and resources, that build leadership and capabilities in Sales, Field, Engineering and Major Projects and our Employee Scholar Program is a notable point of pride, through which Otis sponsors colleagues to pursue degrees or certification programs.

Today, our focus more than ever is on people. As a global, people-powered company, we put people – passengers, customers, and colleagues – at the center of everything we do.  We are guided by our values that we call our Three Absolutes – prioritizing Safety, Ethics, Quality in all that we do. If you would like to learn more about environmental, social and governance (ESG) at Otis click here.

Become a part of the Otis team and help us #Buildwhatsnext!

Questo ruolo funge da partner commerciale strategico per i team operativi e commerciali, fornendo informazioni finanziarie che guidano prestazioni, redditività e crescita a lungo termine. Il candidato ideale combinerà un forte acume finanziario con la comprensione del business e la capacità di sfidare le ipotesi, identificare rischi e opportunità e supportare il processo decisionale basato sui dati. Responsabilità chiave: pianificazione finanziaria e budget:
• Guidare il budget annuale e i processi di previsione trimestrale, lavorando a stretto contatto con i team regionali, le vendite, l'assistenza e le operazioni.
• Consolidare i piani finanziari e preparare analisi di scenario per supportare le decisioni del management. Analisi e reporting delle prestazioni:
• Monitorare i principali parametri finanziari (ad esempio, ricavi, margine, OPEX, capitale circolante) e fornire informazioni utili alla leadership senior.
• Preparare report mensili sulle prestazioni, dashboard e analisi degli scostamenti rispetto al budget e alle previsioni. Supporto aziendale strategico:

Role Overview:

The FP&A Manager is responsible for leading the financial planning, forecasting, budgeting, and analysis activities for Otis Switzerland. This role acts as a strategic business partner to operational and commercial teams, delivering financial insights that drive performance, profitability, and long-term growth. The ideal candidate will combine strong financial acumen with business understanding and an ability to challenge assumptions, identify risks and opportunities, and support data-driven decision-making.

Key Responsibilities:

Financial Planning and Budgeting:

• Lead the annual budget and quarterly forecast processes, working closely with regional teams, sales, service, and operations.

• Consolidate financial plans and prepare scenario analyses to support management decisions.

Performance Analysis and Reporting:

• Monitor key financial metrics (e.g., revenue, margin, OPEX, working capital) and provide actionable insights to senior leadership.

• Prepare monthly performance reports, dashboards, and variance analyses against budget and forecast.

Strategic Business Support:

• Partner with commercial, service, and operations leaders to evaluate business performance and support strategic initiatives such as pricing strategies, cost optimization, or capital investment.

• Provide financial input for business cases, tenders, and investment proposals (e.g., modernization projects, new installations, or M&A activity).

Cash Flow and Working Capital Management:

• Support the monitoring and forecasting of cash flow, collections, and project-related working capital.

• Analyze trends in billing, collections, and inventory to improve capital efficiency.

Tools, Systems & Process Improvement:

• Drive improvements in FP&A tools, models, and processes, ensuring scalability and accuracy of financial insights.

• Collaborate with IT and Controlling to streamline data flow and reporting systems (e.g., ERP, BI tools).

Governance and Compliance:

• Ensure adherence to internal controls, group policies, and financial reporting standards.

• Support audits and internal reviews related to financial planning and forecasting.

Qualifications, Competencies and Skills:

• Bachelor’s or master’s degree in accounting, Finance, or a related field.

• Proficiency in both German & English. French and Italian are a plus.

• Extensive experience in accounting and good understanding of construction accounting practices, including job costing, percentage of completion, and project-based financial management.

• Proficiency with accounting software and advanced Excel skills.

• Strong leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills to collaborate with business partners and the different departments across Otis Switzerland

If you live in a city, chances are we will give you a lift or play a role in keeping you moving every day.

Otis is the world’s leading elevator and escalator manufacturing, installation, and service company. We move 2.4 billion people every day and maintain approximately 2.4 million customer units worldwide, the industry's largest Service portfolio.

You may recognize our products in some of the world’s most famous landmarks including the Eiffel Tower, Empire State Building, Burj Khalifa and the Petronas Twin Towers! We are 72,000 people strong, including engineers, digital technology experts, sales, and functional specialists, as well as factory and field technicians, all committed to meeting the diverse needs of our customers and passengers in more than 200 countries and territories worldwide. We are proud to be a diverse, global team with a proven legacy of innovation that continues to be the bedrock of a fast-moving, high-performance company.

When you join Otis, you become part of an innovative global industry leader with a resilient business model. You’ll belong to a diverse, trusted, and caring community where your contributions, and the skills and capabilities you’ll gain working alongside the best and brightest, keep us connected and on the cutting edge.

We provide opportunities, training, and resources, that build leadership and capabilities in Sales, Field, Engineering and Major Projects and our Employee Scholar Program is a notable point of pride, through which Otis sponsors colleagues to pursue degrees or certification programs.

Today, our focus more than ever is on people. As a global, people-powered company, we put people – passengers, customers, and colleagues – at the center of everything we do. We are guided by our values that we call our Three Absolutes – prioritizing Safety, Ethics, Quality in all that we do.
